# v2.74-dev — take the name off the browser tab too

A follow-up to the branding work in v2.73.

## What's new

**The application name can now be removed from the browser tab.** v2.73 let you replace the name everywhere, and hide it on the login page — but the tab still had to say *something*, so an install that wanted no product name visible at all was left with one in the tab.

**Admin → System Settings → Branding** gains a **Show the name in the browser tab** switch, on by default. Turn it off and the page is left untitled, so the browser shows the address instead of a name.

If you want a *different* name rather than none, nothing changes: set the Application name and leave the switch on.
